name: The Burning Axe of Sankis
notes: The Burning Axe of Sankis (diablocraft-pl8fc, ruling 2026-10-11): the buff the wearer sees while the 35% / 4 s window of its `triggered` row is up. The number is that row's own (data/legendary_powers.csv owner and stat), the seconds are its cond_arg, set by the module (dc_item_powers.cpp Fire); display only, the reduction is the row's (ItemPower::ReductionFactor). Donor Shield Wall, for its icon.

name: Stone Gauntlets
notes: Stone Gauntlets (diablocraft-ghb4o, PM 2026-10-12): the buff a hit taken stacks, up to the `stack_buff` row's stack_max, on its stack_seconds that each hit refreshes. $s1 is one stack's armor (the `buff` armor_pct row) and CumulativeAura is stack_max, so the client shows the total; the armor itself is the module's sheet contribution, read from this aura's stacks (dc_item_powers.cpp StackSheet). Donor Stoneform, for its icon.

name: Stone Gauntlets
notes: Stone Gauntlets' slow (diablocraft-ghb4o): the companion of 83551, stacked and timed with it, a stock SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED of the `buff` movement_speed_pct row per stack with the Snare mechanic, so control immunity takes it off and keeps it off while the armor stays (PM 2026-10-12: Blizzard calls that intended). The attack speed penalty is read from its stacks (ItemPowers::AttackSpeedFactor), so it goes with it. Donor Earthbind, for its icon.

name: Orb of Infinite Depth
text: Damage taken reduced by $s1% and damage dealt increased.
notes: Orb of Infinite Depth (diablocraft-anpkx, N-STACKBUFF): the buff each Explosive Blast hit stacks, up to the `stack_buff` row's stack_max 4, on its 6 s that each hit refreshes. $s1 is one stack's reduction (the `buff` damage_reduction_pct row, 20) and CumulativeAura is 4, so the client shows the total; the damage dealt rolls per item (8-10), so the record cannot state it and names it only. Both are the module's, read from this aura's stacks (ItemPowers::DealtFactor, IncomingFactor). Donor Arcane Power, for its icon.

name: Cow
notes: Bovine Bardiche (diablocraft-4p9j9): not a buff but the name-only record the cows' damage is dealt and logged under (a gem `hit` record's shape: no effect, no aura, Physical), so the combat log reads 'Cow'. The damage is the module's (dc_item_summons.cpp Swing: ComputeHit at the cow's percent, DealHit). Donor Stampede, for its icon.

name: Bindings of the Lesser Gods
text: Takes increased damage from the Mystic Ally of the one who marked it.
notes: Bindings of the Lesser Gods (diablocraft-zhizu, PM 2026-10-14): the mark a Cyclone Strike hit puts on an enemy, a debuff record on the ENEMY (SPELL_ATTR0_AURA_IS_DEBUFF, one SPELL_AURA_DUMMY, no baked number: the rolled percent is stored in the aura's effect amount when the module applies it, dc_item_powers.cpp MarkEnemy), its seconds the `mark_enemy` row's stack_seconds. The first `mark` kind: Delsere's Magnum Opus and Cesar's Memento use the same shape. Donor Hunter's Mark, for its icon.

name: Binding of the Lost
notes: Binding of the Lost (diablocraft-9ao0o, N-STACKBUFF): the buff each Seven-Sided Strike hit stacks, up to the `stack_buff` row's stack_max 7 (or the tunable monk.binding_of_the_lost_max_stacks), on one 7 s timer that each hit refreshes. The reduction rolls per item (4-5 per stack), so the record states no number (generate_spells.py power_buff_number: a rolled dummy) and CumulativeAura is 7; the reduction is the module's, read from this aura's stacks (ItemPowers::IncomingFactor). Donor Divine Protection, for its icon.

name: Fiery Ball
notes: Storm Crow (diablocraft-lm3ka): not a buff but the name-only record the fiery ball's damage is dealt and logged under (a gem `hit` record's shape: no effect, no aura), Fire school so the combat log reads 'Fiery Ball' as a fire hit. The damage is the module's (dc_item_proc.cpp Damage: ComputeHit at the storm_crow_fireball_damage_pct tunable, DealHit). Donor Fireball, for its icon.

name: Burn the Ground
notes: Fire Walkers (diablocraft-4na3e, N-AREA): not a buff but the name-only record the burning ground's damage is dealt and logged under (a gem `hit` record's shape: no effect, no aura), Fire school so the combat log reads 'Burn the Ground' (d3planner's name for the power, leg_firewalkers_p2) as a fire hit. The damage is the module's (dc_item_trail.cpp Burn: ComputeHit at the item's rolled percent of weapon damage per second times the drop period, as a periodic hit, then DealHit). Donor Flamestrike, for its icon.

name: Blood Brother
text: Your next attack inflicts $s1% additional damage.
notes: Blood Brother (diablocraft-jxvsn, N-BLOCK): the aura a block puts on the wearer while the next attack is armed. Untimed (it ends when an attack connects or the sword comes off); $s1 is the `effect` next_attack_pct row's fixed 30 (Power file SF_1), and the module keeps the percent in the aura's effect amount (dc_item_powers.cpp ArmNextAttack), which is what the next hit reads (ItemPowers::NextAttackFactor); display and state only, the damage is the module's. Donor Shield Block, for its icon.

name: Wall of Man
notes: Wall of Man (diablocraft-44hz9, rebuilt in diablocraft-upwsv, ruling q-1021-91 (a)): the protection the wearer sees, a timed dummy aura the executor puts on for the file's 8 s; $s1 is the `buff` damage_reduction_pct row's 25 and the module reads the aura's stack as the percent every hit taken is smaller by (ItemPower::StackedFactor, as Orb of Infinite Depth's); the icon is stock Bone Shield's

name: Fleshrake
notes: Fleshrake (diablocraft-k2yzl, N-STACKBUFF): the buff each use of Dashing Strike stacks, up to the `stack_buff` row's stack_max 5, on its 1 s that each use refreshes. The damage per stack rolls per item (75-100), so the record states no number (generate_spells.py power_buff_number: a rolled dummy) and CumulativeAura is 5; the bonus is the module's, read from this aura's stacks (ItemPowers::StackedSkillFactor). Donor Shadowstep (Dashing Strike's own), for its icon.

name: Spectral
notes: Fragment of Destiny (diablocraft-d1lq1, N-STACKBUFF): the buff each Signature Spell attack stacks, up to the stack_buff row's stack_max 10, on its stack_seconds that each attack refreshes. The damage per stack rolls per item (20-30) and is read from the stacks by ItemPowers::StackedSkillFactor for Hydra. Icon 36554 is Fleshrake's (a placeholder look)
